create_project: create a new litellm project with models, budget limits, and metadata for a team
update_project: update an existing litellm project's description, budget, or model rpm limits
delete_project: delete one or more litellm projects by their project ids after removing associated keys
get_project_info: get detailed information about a specific litellm project including its budget and permissions
list_projects: list all litellm projects accessible to the current user or all projects for proxy admins
